title: When the Shaking Comes a Great Awakening
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a prophetic word about the shaking that's coming to our nation and the church, and how it will bring about a great unity and outpouring of God's glory. He draws on Scripture and historical examples of revivals to paint a vivid picture of what's on the horizon, and challenges believers to be open to the leading of the Holy Spirit in these uncertain times. Whether you're a seasoned leader or just starting your faith journey, this sermon will inspire you to trust in God's plans and be a part of the awakening that's coming.
